In addition to participating in Amazon's updated early autumn Prime Day sale and the ongoing $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance deal has also returned, offering nearly $200 off the original price. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also includes $150 off the Apple 24GB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, the return of launch discounts on Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini, and nearly 20% off the Apple Magic Keyboard. Add to that Beats braided USB-C cables for under $8, plus a range of brand-new exclusive discounts on iPhone 18 Pro cases. Scroll down for details.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (original price $249)

Restocked: Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop hits historic clearance low, nearly $200 off

The Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 have officially launched, and we're continuing to track early launch deals across multiple models on Amazon. Related deals will be listed below, and clearance discounts on the two most popular Apple Watch Ultra models have been restocked on Amazon with nearly $200 off.

Amazon is now selling both the black titanium and natural titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models, paired with a matching Milanese Loop, for $699.97 (including shipping).

That's $199 less than the $899 original price and the Ultra 4's pricing.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (original price $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (original price $899)

We saw these two deals yesterday, but stock was extremely unstable, going in and out. Now it seems they're back. These historic clearance lows on Apple Watch models shortly after new releases often offer the best value in wearables for users who don't need the latest and greatest specs, and the Ultra 3 remains a more-than-capable performer that looks nearly identical to the new model.

Here are the launch discounts currently available on the Series 12 and Ultra 4:

Apple Watch Series 12

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $390 (original price $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $440 (original price $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $540 (original price $549)

Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4 GPS + Cellular 49mm: $780 (original price $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4, 49mm, GPS + Cellular: $780 (original price $799)

Apple 24GB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air drops $150 on Amazon, up to $300 off refurbished

While we're still tracking up to $300 off the 15-inch models through Apple's official refurbished store, Amazon is now selling several 13-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air configurations for $150 below the original price.

Apple's official refurbished store has been a great place to score deals on the M5 MacBook Air, especially over the past three months or so. However, stock may be very limited, and current discounts apply only to 15-inch models.

Meanwhile, Amazon is offering $150 off brand-new 14-inch models, including the mid-tier 1TB configuration and the upgraded 24GB RAM variant:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (original price $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (original price $1,799)

As for the Apple refurbished deals, color options have become more limited since we last covered them, but you can still grab select models with up to $300 off:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,269 (original price $1,499 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (original price $1,999 new)
  • Starlight, Sky Blue

Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini launch discount returns

On top of the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals and early launch discounts on the Apple Watch Series 12, Amazon has brought back the launch discount on Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini.

Amazon is once again selling the new M6 Mac mini with 24GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,269.99 (including shipping).

While the discount off the $1,299 MSRP isn't huge, this new machine has dropped back to the lowest price we've tracked—welcome savings for those who want to get in early. M6 Mac mini launch deals have been somewhat up and down since launch, occasionally bouncing back to MSRP, but as of writing we have two configurations on offer again.

Beyond the 24GB model deal, there's also a discount on the mid-tier 16GB configuration—we'll keep watching for deals on the entry-level model and the M5 Pro version:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (original price $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (original price $1,299)

Most affordable USB-C Apple Magic Keyboard at nearly 20% off, today only

Add Hyper's latest Thunderbolt 5 expansion dock to your new Mac setup for $80 off (Amazon low)

One of Hyper's newest MacBook and Mac mini/Studio accessories has dropped back to its lowest tracked Amazon price—the HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 SSD Dock, $80 off.

The brand's official Amazon store is once again selling its latest HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 SSD Dock for $319.99 (including shipping).

Down from $400, this discount matches the previous deal we mentioned, hitting the $80 low that Amazon has tracked since launch earlier this year.

All-new Beats 360 ANC headphones launch deal: modular Cushion Kit for $10, 80% off

As mentioned yesterday in the larger Beats roundup, Apple's sub-brand has officially launched the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones featuring modular ear cup and headband cushion design. Now on sale, we're also seeing Beats 360 launch deals with limited-time pricing on the Beats 360 Cushion Kit—just $9.99.

The all-new Beats 360 headphones feature a modular system so users can swap and replace ear cups and headband cushions. The headphones themselves ship with a matching Cushion Kit, but there are seven different colors of Beats 360 Cushion Kit available at a discount right now so you can mix and match styles, or swap in a fresh set after a workout.

  • Beats 360 over-ear headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (original price $50)

Early autumn Prime Day Ring deals from $40: latest 4K model hits new low, $100 off, more

Early autumn Amazon Prime Day deals have landed on the Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro and Battery wireless models, both now at new Amazon lows—60% off. Scroll down for details and additional early autumn Prime Big Deal Days offers on other Ring models starting from $40 (including shipping).

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (original price $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (original price $250)

What you're looking at here are Ring's two newest 4K video smart doorbells, both priced at $250. After $100 off, that's a 60% discount and a new Amazon all-time low—before these early autumn Prime deals, neither model had ever dipped below $180.

Although Amazon kicked off early autumn Prime Day deals early this year before the October 6 launch date, it's clearly continuing to stack new—and very attractive—deals onto the early autumn sale.

These two options are largely identical in features, with the only difference being whether you go wired or completely wireless on battery power—the wireless model comes with a Quick Release Ultra battery pack for easy charging and a potentially simpler install (no wiring required), while the wired model offers "nonstop power, nonstop protection." Beyond that, both feature 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K video.
